description.value: VIVA Cafe & Bakery is a community-rooted café and bakery that has been serving the Kitsilano neighbourhood since 2002, located steps from Kitsilano Beach. The shop is known for specialty espresso sourced from boutique Canadian roasters and for house-made pastries crafted fresh each morning by two in-house pastry chefs. A recent renovation introduced a new space that blends contemporary coffee culture with the café's long-standing community traditions.
